{'text': '政府晚上10時02分出稿指，海關轉介警方國安處，指在一批由境外寄到香港的貨物內，發現具煽動意圖書籍。國安處今日在旺角搜查兩間店鋪，拘捕五人，包括兩名37歲及57歲的男子，及三名30歲至59歲的女子。五名被捕人，被指涉嫌違反《維護國家安全條例》第二十四條「出於煽動意圖作出具煽動意圖的作為」罪。', 'en': 'At 10:02 p.m., the government issued a statement saying that the Customs and Excise Department had referred the case to the National Security Division of the police, indicating that books with seditious intent had been discovered in a batch of goods mailed from outside Hong Kong to the city. The National Security Division today searched two shops in Mong Kok and arrested five people, including two men aged 37 and 57, and three women aged between 30 and 59. The five arrested are suspected of violating Article 24 of the Safeguarding National Security Ordinance, the offense of "committing an act with seditious intent with a seditious intent."'}

{'text': '新聞稿指，警方調查顯示，五名被捕人涉嫌在店內，展示具煽動意圖的物品，及出售具煽動意圖刊物，內容包括煽動他人引起對香港特區政府、司法機構及執法部門的憎恨，又指在店內檢取一批涉案的「具煽動意圖書籍」。五人正被扣留調查。警方指，「出於煽動意圖作出具煽動意圖的作為」，首次定罪可被判監七年。', 'en': 'The press release stated that police investigations showed the five arrestees were suspected of displaying items with seditious intent in the shop and selling publications with seditious intent, including content that incited hatred toward the Hong Kong SAR government, the judiciary, and law enforcement agencies. It also indicated that a batch of "seditious books" related to the case had been seized from the premises. The five are being detained for investigation. Police stated that a first conviction for "committing an act with seditious intent with a seditious intent" can result in a prison sentence of up to seven years.'}

{'text': '據了解，昨日（14日）宣布會在8時30分結業的留下書舍，今早（15日）有警察上門調查。留下書舍的窗口，下午已拉起百葉簾。有出版社人員到該幢樓宇送書，被查證件，其後獲放行。', 'en': "It is understood that Leave Bookstore, which yesterday (the 14th) announced it would close at 8:30 p.m., was visited by police for investigation this morning (the 15th). By the afternoon, the blinds at Leave Bookstore's windows had been pulled down. Personnel from a publishing house who went to the building to deliver books had their identification checked before being allowed to leave."}

{'text': '約5時50分，警方將一名女店員押上警車，女店員身穿黑衣，衣服寫上「我是書店店員」，她被鎖上手銬押走。警方行動結束後，書店外的電影海報仍在，書店鎖上鐵閘，門外海報印有「活得真誠磊落」幾字。書店窗口，一幅有前後「自由」、「風雨」的毛巾被移走。', 'en': 'At approximately 5:50 p.m., police escorted a female shop assistant onto a police vehicle. The assistant, dressed in black with the words "I am a bookstore employee" written on her clothes, was handcuffed and led away. After the police operation ended, the movie posters outside the bookstore remained, and the bookstore\'s iron gate was locked. A poster outside the door bore the words "Live Truthfully and With Integrity." A towel bearing the words "Freedom" and "Wind and Rain" on opposite sides was removed from the bookstore window.'}

{'text': '另一家獨立書店田園書屋，據了解亦被警方搜查。下午4時30分左右，警方帶走一名男子，另搬走四個藍色膠箱、一個黑色行李箱。', 'en': 'Another independent bookstore, Garden Bookhouse (Tin Yuen), was also reportedly searched by police. At approximately 4:30 p.m., police took away a man and also removed four blue plastic crates and a black suitcase.'}

{'text': '今日約下午一時，幾名便衣警察到太子的留下書舍搜查，期間有便衣警察帶着藍色膠箱上樓，約兩個小時後，警察穿上印有「police」背心，有出版社人員送貨上樓，遭警方搜查，其後獲放行。下午不時有市民上樓剪頭髮或上班，如常通行，沒有遭警方截查。', 'en': 'At approximately 1 p.m. today, several plainclothes police officers went to Leave Bookstore in Prince Edward to conduct a search. During this time, plainclothes officers carried blue plastic crates upstairs. Approximately two hours later, officers donned vests printed with the word "police." Personnel from a publishing house delivering goods upstairs were searched by police before being allowed to leave. During the afternoon, citizens frequently went upstairs for haircuts or work, passing through as usual without being stopped for checks by police.'}

{'text': '2022年開業的留下書舍，由資深傳媒人岑蘊華及幾位前傳媒人創立，主打跟新聞題材有關的書籍，也有舉行讀者分享會等活動。近月國安警先後對一拳書館、獵人書店等採取拘捕行動，留下書舍昨在社交媒體發表結業預告，表示最近的事態，也許是駱駝背上的最後一根稻草，難以捉摸的紅線，也是一個結業原因。他們在聲明指，局長之前明言，不會交代甚麼書不可賣，而書店「無能力判斷甚麼書才是『有問題』。」', 'en': 'Leave Bookstore, which opened in 2022, was founded by veteran media professional Sham Wan-wah and several former media professionals, focusing on books related to news topics and also holding reader sharing sessions and other activities. In recent months, national security police have taken arrest actions against bookstores such as One Two Bookstore and Hunter Bookstore. Yesterday, Leave Bookstore posted a closure notice on social media, stating that recent developments may be the final straw that broke the camel\'s back, and that the hard-to-pin-down red line was also a reason for shutting down. In their statement, they noted that the Secretary had previously stated clearly that there would be no clarification on which books could not be sold, and that the bookstore "had no ability to judge which books are \'problematic.\'"'}

{'text': '今年陸續有獨立書店捲入國安案件，也有獨立書店被貿發局取消參展資格。今年三月，一拳書館負責人龐一鳴及三職員被國安警拘捕，四人被指涉及23條下的「明知而出售具煽動意圖刊物」罪，書店內的《黎智英傳》等被檢走。龐一鳴早前也因書館辦西班牙文興趣班被控違《教育條例》，遭罰款3.2萬元。去年六月舉辦棟篤笑舞台表演，被控「無牌公眾娛樂場所罪」，違反《公眾娛樂場所條例》，他及公司各被判罰3000元，合共罰款6000元。', 'en': 'This year, independent bookstores have successively become embroiled in national security cases, and some have had their exhibition qualifications revoked by the Trade and Industry Department. In March this year, Pang Yat-ming, the person in charge of One Two Bookstore, and three staff members were arrested by national security police. The four were accused of the offense of "knowingly selling publications with seditious intent" under Article 23, and books including "The Jimmy Lai Story" were seized from the store. Pang Yat-ming was previously also prosecuted for violating the Education Ordinance over a Spanish language interest class held at the store and was fined HK$32,000. A stand-up comedy stage performance held last June led to charges of "operating an unlicensed place of public entertainment," violating the Places of Public Entertainment Ordinance, with him and his company each fined HK$3,000, totaling HK$6,000.'}

{'text': '今年6月29日，獵人書店創辦人黃文萱夫婦被國安警以涉嫌違23條下的「出於煽動意圖作出具煽動意圖作為」罪，及涉嫌洗黑錢等罪名拘捕。數日後，傳出榆林書店及樂文書店突遭貿發局取消參加香港書展的消息。會展的書展，是獨立書店一年重要的收入來源。據知書店也準備了大批的書本，突然遭貿發局DQ（取消資格），兩書店都要減價清貨，榆林書店在上周宣布，明年四月租約滿，將「光榮結束門市」。', 'en': 'On June 29 this year, Hunter Bookstore founders Wong Man-huen and her husband were arrested by national security police on suspicion of violating Article 23 with the offense of "committing an act with seditious intent with a seditious intent," as well as suspected money laundering. Several days later, news emerged that Yulin Bookstore and Lock Road Bookstore had suddenly had their participation in the Hong Kong Book Fair revoked by the Trade and Industry Department. The book fair at the convention center is an important annual source of income for independent bookstores. It is understood that the bookstores had also prepared large quantities of books, but after being suddenly disqualified by the Trade and Industry Department, both had to hold clearance sales. Last week, Yulin Bookstore announced that with its lease expiring next April, it would "gloriously close its retail store."'}
